_what: Starter feedback stages, derived from first principles (components/feedback-forms/principles.json) with no brand facts yet: every form waits on the facts it names. Fill brands/<brand>/operations/feedback-variables.json and run components/feedback-forms/stages.py; nothing here assumes a platform, a business model or a timing.
label: <Brand>

form.link_note: Put this exact link on the email's button, with {stage} filled in. `e` is the profile's email so the answer lands on the right Klaviyo profile. The page reads it, then wipes it from the address bar before anything else runs; the page loads no ad pixels, so the email never reaches Meta/TikTok/Snap. If Klaviyo click tracking adds `_kx` to the link, the page uses that instead and `e` can be dropped.
form.repo: <where the form page lives: the store's theme or a page repo>

email.style: Made by the email production tool in the brand's design system and voice: one clear button to the form. Footer as the brand's other emails have it ({% unsubscribe %} · {{ organization.name }} {{ organization.full_address }}).
email.reward: Optional: put a thank-you code in feedback-questions.json › reward.code and the last screen shows it.

stages.label: On the list, never bought
stages.why: They chose to hear from the brand but haven't bought: only they can say what is holding them back and what they use instead.

flow_filters: the order event — zero times over all time
Has not been in this flow over all time (one form per person per moment)
klaviyo.why_the_wait: after the welcome emails have made the brand's case, or the answer is about emails they haven't read yet

stages.blocked_by: needs has_email_signup — people can join the list without buying (from the site: a signup form or pop-up); joined_list_event — the event name(s) when someone joins the list (from the email platform's metrics list (Klaviyo's own: 'Subscribed to List')); order_placed_event — the event name(s) for a placed order, one per store or checkout (from the email platform's metrics list, the ones still firing); email_platform — what sends the flows (from the brand's email account (klaviyo is the one supported today)); welcome_series_days — how many days the welcome emails run after someone joins (from the email platform's welcome flow); buffer_days — days to leave after an order or service email before asking anything (from the brand's own sending rules)

stages.label: Started checkout, didn't buy
stages.why: They decided to buy and stopped at the last step: only they know which doubt or friction stopped them.

flow_filters: the order event — zero times over all time
Has not been in this flow over all time (one form per person per moment)
klaviyo.why_the_wait: after the recovery emails have had their turn, so the form doesn't compete with them

stages.blocked_by: needs checkout_started_event — the event name(s) when someone starts checkout, one per store or checkout the brand sells through (from the email platform's metrics list, the ones still firing); order_placed_event — the event name(s) for a placed order, one per store or checkout (from the email platform's metrics list, the ones still firing); email_platform — what sends the flows (from the brand's email account (klaviyo is the one supported today)); checkout_recovery_days — how many days the abandoned-checkout emails run (from the email platform's checkout flow); buffer_days — days to leave after an order or service email before asking anything (from the brand's own sending rules)

stages.label: First order, delivered
stages.why: They have used the product for the first time: only they can say whether it did what the ads promised, and what they'd say to a friend.

flow_filters: the order event — equals 1 over all time
Has not been in this flow over all time (one form per person per moment)
klaviyo.why_the_wait: once the product has had time to do what it promises; asked earlier, the answer is a guess

stages.blocked_by: needs delivered_event — the event name the email platform receives when an order is delivered (from the email platform's metrics list (Shopify + Klaviyo: 'Delivered Shipment', if delivery tracking is on)); order_placed_event — the event name(s) for a placed order, one per store or checkout (from the email platform's metrics list, the ones still firing); email_platform — what sends the flows (from the brand's email account (klaviyo is the one supported today)); time_to_first_result_days — days after delivery before the product shows what it promises (from the product facts and claims (products/<product>/product.md), not a guess); refund_event — the event name for a refund (from the email platform's metrics list (Shopify + Klaviyo: 'Refunded Order'))

stages.label: Ordered again
stages.why: They chose the brand a second time: the reason they came back is freshest the moment they reorder.

flow_filters: the order event — at least 2 over all time
Has not been in this flow over all time (one form per person per moment)
klaviyo.why_the_wait: right after the order, once the order emails are out of the way

stages.blocked_by: needs order_placed_event — the event name(s) for a placed order, one per store or checkout (from the email platform's metrics list, the ones still firing); email_platform — what sends the flows (from the brand's email account (klaviyo is the one supported today)); buffer_days — days to leave after an order or service email before asking anything (from the brand's own sending rules); refund_event — the event name for a refund (from the email platform's metrics list (Shopify + Klaviyo: 'Refunded Order'))

stages.label: Active subscriber
stages.why: They let the brand charge them on repeat: only they know whether the rhythm fits and what nearly made them cancel.

flow_filters: Has not been in this flow over all time (one form per person per moment)
klaviyo.why_the_wait: after a renewal has arrived, so the rhythm is real to them

stages.blocked_by: needs sells_subscriptions — the brand sells on subscription (from the store's products and offers); subscription_renewed_event — the event name for a renewal order, as the subscription app sends it (from the subscription app's integration with the email platform); email_platform — what sends the flows (from the brand's email account (klaviyo is the one supported today)); buffer_days — days to leave after an order or service email before asking anything (from the brand's own sending rules)

stages.label: Refunded
stages.why: They asked for their money back: only they can say what broke between the promise and the product.

flow_filters: Has not been in this flow over all time (one form per person per moment)
klaviyo.why_the_wait: soon, while it's fresh, but not inside the refund's own emails

stages.blocked_by: needs refund_event — the event name for a refund (from the email platform's metrics list (Shopify + Klaviyo: 'Refunded Order')); email_platform — what sends the flows (from the brand's email account (klaviyo is the one supported today)); buffer_days — days to leave after an order or service email before asking anything (from the brand's own sending rules)

stages.label: Cancelled subscription
stages.why: They stopped the subscription: only they can say why it stopped fitting.

flow_filters: Has not been in this flow over all time (one form per person per moment)

stages.blocked_by: needs sells_subscriptions — the brand sells on subscription (from the store's products and offers); subscription_cancelled_event — the event name for a cancelled subscription (from the subscription app's integration); email_platform — what sends the flows (from the brand's email account (klaviyo is the one supported today)); buffer_days — days to leave after an order or service email before asking anything (from the brand's own sending rules)

stages.label: After a support request
stages.why: They needed help: only they can say whether the help worked and what the site should have answered first.

flow_filters: Has not been in this flow over all time (one form per person per moment)
klaviyo.why_the_wait: after the reply, while the experience is fresh

stages.blocked_by: needs ticket_resolved_event — the event name for a closed support ticket (from the helpdesk's integration with the email platform); email_platform — what sends the flows (from the brand's email account (klaviyo is the one supported today)); buffer_days — days to leave after an order or service email before asking anything (from the brand's own sending rules)
